시편-139-1.title: 시편 139장 1절 역사문법적 주해
시편-139-1.exegesis: PSALM 139 Psa 139:1-24 . After presenting the sublime doctrines of God's omnipresence and omniscience, the Psalmist appeals to Him, avowing his innocence, his abhorrence of the wicked, and his ready submission to the closest scrutiny. Admonition to the wicked and comfort to the pious are alike implied inferences from these doctrines.
